'''April 2000 Williston Park tournament (29 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Grasshopper's Comics, Williston Park, NY on 29 April 2000. [[Derek Halpern]] won it. It is known from Brad Vogel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d634">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-williston-park-new-york-4-29-00d634/ williston-park-new-york-4-29-00], DeckTech (Brad "Uncle Chall" Vogel, 30 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-williston-park-new-york-4-29-00d634/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Grasshopper's Comics, Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Derek Halpern]]
